verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software or AI product that ingests user data and offers an AI-training opt-out, so this privacy-control axis is a category error for this product type. Its Data Protection & Privacy practice advises clients on compliance. That is a legal service on an adjacent topic, not a product control over the user's own data, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
